caseNameFull: Warner Bros. Pictures, Inc. v. United States
attorneys: .Messrs. Frederick H. Wood, James A. Peed, Sam B. Jeffries, R. W. Perkins, Louis Phillips, S. W. Fordyce, Wm. R. Gentry, Wm. J. Donovan, and Jacob M. Lashly for appellants. Solicitor Generdo Reed for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion of the appellee to affirm is granted and the decree is affirmed. Pullman’s Car Co. v. Transportation Co., 171 U. S. 138, 145-146; McGowan v. Columbia River Packers’ Assn., 245 U. S. 352, 358; Ex parte Skinner & Eddy Corp., 265 U. S. 86, 93-94; Jones v. Securities & Exchange Comm’n, ante, p. 1.
